summary: Agent collected appropriate verification details but appears to have initiated and confirmed a return/order action without first pulling up the account (no 'Account has been pulled up' system log). All other categories show no violations.

findings.quote: Okay. Let's set up that return then. I will need your email and order ID.
findings.explanation: The agent states they will 'set up that return' before there is any system evidence that the account was pulled up. Policy requires the agent to pull up the account (full name or account ID) before any account or order action.

findings.quote: Alright, your return is set up. Your shipping label will be emailed to you so you can print it off. Will that be all for today?
findings.explanation: The agent confirms the return is complete. System turns (turn 28: 'Order has been updated with By Mail') show the order was changed, but there is no 'Account has been pulled up' system log and the agent never requested a full name or account ID first. According to policy this is a major violation: an order action was taken/confirmed without the required prior account pull-up verification.
